Israil ilekshan rijalt ke bad se arab partiyon ki ahmitay barhi hai. ye arab partiyan kingmekar ki bhumika ada kar sakti hain. magar israil ki zyadatar pramukh yahudi netritv vali rajnitik partiyan arab partiyon ke samarthan par nirbhar rahne se bachti hain. aaj pahli khabar men isi ki bat ki israil men arab partiyon se koee parti samarthan kyon nahin le rahi?
Aavaz- shahid
